Scenario: New pilot case matching an open case of the same customer and system is flagged for the dispatcher
Preconditions: Pilot tenant with F-01 transported; feature toggle ON. Customer account ACME GmbH (1000123). Open case 4711 exists: ACME, system ID PRD, category 'System copy / refresh', status 'In Process'. Dispatcher user DISP_01 (role Support Dispatcher) logged in to Service Cloud v2.
Steps: 1) As customer user ACME_CUST1 in SAP for Me, create a case: category 'System copy / refresh', system ID PRD, description 'Refresh QAS from PRD on 20.11'. Note the new case ID (e.g. 4720) and the creation time. 2) As DISP_01, open the dispatcher queue and refresh until case 4720 appears. 3) Open case 4720 and read the fields 'Possible duplicate of' and 'Duplicate decision'. 4) Click the link in 'Possible duplicate of'.
Expected_Result: Case 4720 shows 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711 within 2 minutes of creation [ASSUMPTION target]. 'Duplicate decision' is empty. The link opens case 4711. Case 4720 is in the queue before DISP_01 starts working on it. The customer was not blocked and received no automatic message about the duplicate.

Scenario: Dispatcher confirms the duplicate
Preconditions: TC-US01-01 completed: case 4720 flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711, decision empty. DISP_01 logged in.
Steps: 1) As DISP_01, open case 4720. 2) Set 'Duplicate decision' = 'Confirmed'. 3) Close the case with reason 'Duplicate'. 4) Save. 5) Open case 4711 and check its status and related cases.
Expected_Result: Case 4720 is closed with reason 'Duplicate' and stays linked to 4711. Case 4711 remains open with status 'In Process', unchanged. No automatic e-mail or notification goes to ACME about the duplicate; only the standard closure notification configured today (if any) is sent after the dispatcher action.

Scenario: Dispatcher rejects the flag because it is a new need
Preconditions: New case 4721 for ACME, system PRD, pilot category, flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711. DISP_01 logged in.
Steps: 1) As DISP_01, open case 4721. 2) Set 'Duplicate decision' = 'Rejected' with reason 'Not a duplicate - new need'. 3) Save. 4) Assign the case to engineer ENG_01 as in the normal flow.
Expected_Result: Decision 'Rejected' and the reason are saved. Case 4721 stays open, is not closed or merged, and can be assigned to ENG_01 normally. Case 4711 is unchanged.

Scenario: Dispatcher tries to save a decision without a reason code
Preconditions: Case 4722 flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711. DISP_01 logged in.
Steps: 1) As DISP_01, open case 4722. 2) Set 'Duplicate decision' = 'Rejected' and leave the reason empty. 3) Click Save.
Expected_Result: Save is rejected with a validation message that a reason is required (exact wording per in-app validation, same pattern as override reason R5). No decision is stored and no 'dispatcher decision' event is logged.

Scenario: No match: same customer and category, different system ID
Preconditions: Open case 4711: ACME, PRD, pilot category, 'In Process'. No open ACME pilot case for system QAS.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case with system ID QAS (new case 4723). 2) As DISP_01, open case 4723 after 2 minutes.
Expected_Result: 'Possible duplicate of' is empty and no flag is shown. Case 4723 follows the normal dispatcher flow with no extra delay.

Scenario: No match: earlier case for same customer and system is already closed
Preconditions: Case 4700: ACME, PRD, pilot category, status 'Closed' (not in the open status list). No other open ACME PRD pilot case.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for system PRD (new case 4724). 2) As DISP_01, open case 4724 after 2 minutes.
Expected_Result: No flag is set on 4724. Closed case 4700 is never linked.

Scenario: Support engineer (non-dispatcher) cannot set the duplicate decision
Preconditions: Case 4725 flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711. User ENG_01 has role Support Engineer only (no dispatcher role).
Steps: 1) As ENG_01, open case 4725. 2) Try to edit 'Duplicate decision' and select 'Confirmed'. 3) Try to close the case with reason 'Duplicate'.
Expected_Result: 'Duplicate decision' is read-only for ENG_01 (or the save is rejected with an authorization message). The reason 'Duplicate' is not available to ENG_01 or the save fails. No decision event is logged.

Scenario: Case created via Joule in SAP for Me is flagged end-to-end
Preconditions: Open case 4711 (ACME, PRD, pilot category). Joule in SAP for Me available to ACME_CUST1. CAP service subscribed to the 'case created' event [VERIFY event].
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, start Joule in SAP for Me and ask: 'I need a system refresh of QAS from PRD next week'. 2) Complete the Joule dialogue so that a case is created with category 'System copy / refresh' and system ID PRD (note case 4726). 3) Check that Joule shows the normal confirmation only. 4) As DISP_01, open case 4726 after 2 minutes.
Expected_Result: Joule creates the case and shows only the standard confirmation (no duplicate warning, no block). Case 4726 is flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711 in the dispatcher view.

Scenario: Custom fields and reason codes are transported and active in the pilot tenant
Preconditions: Transport of F-01 configuration released from the test tenant to the pilot tenant.
Steps: 1) As key user KU_01 in the pilot tenant, open Extensibility Administration. 2) Check fields 'Possible duplicate of' and 'Duplicate decision'. 3) Check the code list contains 'Confirmed' / 'Rejected' and reasons 'Duplicate' / 'Not a duplicate - new need'. 4) Open any pilot case as DISP_01 and check the fields are on the layout.
Expected_Result: Both fields exist and are published in the pilot tenant; the code lists contain exactly the four values; the fields are visible on the dispatcher case layout.

Scenario: Technical user reads open pilot cases and writes only the two duplicate fields
Preconditions: Technical user TU_DUPCHK with least-privilege role. OAuth client credentials stored in BTP destination SC2_CASE_API. Open pilot case 4711 and new pilot case 4727 for ACME / PRD.
Steps: 1) Create case 4727 as ACME_CUST1. 2) In the CAP application log on BTP, find the run for case 4727. 3) Check the HTTP calls: query of open cases and PATCH of case 4727. 4) Open case 4727 change history as DISP_01.
Expected_Result: Query and update return success (HTTP 200/204). Change history of 4727 shows only 'Possible duplicate of' changed, changed by TU_DUPCHK. No other field of 4727 or 4711 was changed.

Scenario: Technical user cannot change other case fields
Preconditions: TU_DUPCHK credentials available to the tester in the SIT tenant only (via API client such as Postman, through the BTP destination). Case 4727 open.
Steps: 1) Using TU_DUPCHK, send PATCH to case 4727 setting status = 'Closed'. 2) Send PATCH setting description = 'test'. 3) Send PATCH setting priority = 'Very High'. 4) Send PATCH setting 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711 (allowed field).
Expected_Result: Steps 1-3 are denied (HTTP 403 or field not writable error) and the case is unchanged. Step 4 succeeds. All denied attempts appear in the security log.

Scenario: Technical user cannot read non-pilot or closed cases
Preconditions: Case 5001: ACME, PRD, category 'Performance issue', open. Case 4700: ACME, PRD, pilot category, Closed.
Steps: 1) Using TU_DUPCHK, GET case 5001 by ID. 2) GET case 4700 by ID. 3) Query cases for account 1000123 without a category filter.
Expected_Result: Steps 1 and 2 are denied or return no data. Step 3 returns only open pilot-category cases (no case 5001, no case 4700).

Scenario: Customer isolation: same system ID at a different customer is never linked
Preconditions: Open case 6001: customer Beta AG (1000456), system ID PRD, pilot category, 'In Process'. No open ACME PRD pilot case.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for system PRD (case 4728). 2) As DISP_01, open case 4728 after 2 minutes. 3) Check the CAP log for case 4728.
Expected_Result: No flag is set on 4728; Beta AG case 6001 is never linked. The CAP query for 4728 contains the filter account = 1000123.

Scenario: Customer in self-service cannot see the flag or another case ID
Preconditions: Case 4720 flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711 and decision 'Confirmed' (from TC-US01-02).
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, open case 4720 in SAP for Me. 2) Check all visible fields and the case history. 3) As ACME_CUST1, ask Joule 'show details of my case 4720'.
Expected_Result: Fields 'Possible duplicate of' and 'Duplicate decision' are not shown in SAP for Me or in the Joule answer [VERIFY field visibility]. No internal case ID from the flag is exposed.

Scenario: No secrets in code; credentials only in the BTP destination
Preconditions: Access to the CAP Git repository and the BTP subaccount cockpit (read).
Steps: 1) Search the repository (all branches) for 'clientsecret', 'client_secret', 'password' and the TU_DUPCHK client ID. 2) Check mta.yaml / package.json for credentials. 3) In BTP cockpit, open destination SC2_CASE_API.
Expected_Result: No secret is found in code or config files. Destination SC2_CASE_API uses OAuth2ClientCredentials with TU_DUPCHK. The technical user review by SAP security is recorded and the SoD matrix shows no conflict.

Scenario: Flag and decision events are logged with codes and timestamps only
Preconditions: Case 4729 created as ACME / PRD / pilot category with description 'Refresh QAS - customer contact Mr. Weber, phone +49 170 1234567'. Open case 4711 exists.
Steps: 1) Wait until case 4729 is flagged. 2) As DISP_01, set decision 'Rejected', reason 'Not a duplicate - new need'. 3) In the BTP event store, query events for case 4729. 4) Search the store for 'Weber' and '1234567'.
Expected_Result: Two events exist: 'flag set' (case ID 4729, linked 4711, timestamp) and 'dispatcher decision' (case ID 4729, 'Rejected', reason code, timestamp). The search in step 4 returns nothing: no case free text is stored on BTP.

Scenario: Weekly KPI extract reconciles 1:1 with case history
Preconditions: SIT sample of 20 pilot cases: 8 flagged (5 confirmed, 2 rejected, 1 undecided) and 12 not flagged.
Steps: 1) Run the weekly extract for the SIT week. 2) Count 'flag set' and 'dispatcher decision' rows. 3) Compare each row with the change history of the matching case in Service Cloud v2.
Expected_Result: Extract has 8 'flag set' rows and 7 'dispatcher decision' rows (5 confirmed, 2 rejected). Every row matches case history by case ID, value and timestamp. No extra or missing rows. DPO sign-off that no free text is stored.

Scenario: Wrong or expired OAuth credentials: check fails safely
Preconditions: In SIT, the client secret in destination SC2_CASE_API is changed to an invalid value. Open case 4711 exists.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4730). 2) Check the CAP log. 3) As DISP_01, open the queue. 4) Restore the correct secret.
Expected_Result: Token request fails (HTTP 401); the call is retried up to 3 times, then an error with case ID 4730 is logged. No flag is set. Case 4730 reaches DISP_01's queue normally. After step 4, new cases are checked again.

Scenario: Rule matches only when all criteria are met
Preconditions: Open case 4711: ACME, PRD, pilot category, 'In Process'. Open status list = New, In Process, Customer Action [ASSUMPTION - confirm with support ops].
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4731). 2) Check the CAP log for the match evaluation. 3) Open case 4731 as DISP_01.
Expected_Result: Log shows the match on account 1000123 + system PRD + category 'System copy / refresh' + status 'In Process' + case ID different from 4731. 4731 is flagged with 4711.

Scenario: Several open matches: the oldest is linked and the number is noted
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4743). 2) Open case 4743 as DISP_01. 3) Check the CAP log and the 'flag set' event.
Expected_Result: 'Possible duplicate of' = 4740 (oldest). The number of matches = 3 is noted on the case / in the event. Only one flag is written.

Scenario: Different category at same customer and system does not match
Preconditions: Open case 5001: ACME, PRD, category 'Performance issue'. No open ACME PRD pilot case.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4744). 2) Open case 4744 as DISP_01 after 2 minutes.
Expected_Result: No flag on 4744. Case 5001 is never linked.

Scenario: A case never matches itself
Preconditions: No open ACME PRD pilot case exists.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4745). 2) Check the CAP log: the query result contains 4745 itself. 3) Open 4745 as DISP_01.
Expected_Result: 4745 is excluded from the result (not the same case). No flag is set; 'Possible duplicate of' is not 4745.

Scenario: System ID empty at check time (cleared after creation, E2)
Preconditions: Open case 4711 (ACME, PRD, pilot). Event delivery delayed in SIT so the check runs after edit.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4746). 2) Before the check runs, as DISP_01 clear the system ID on 4746 and save. 3) Let the event be processed. 4) Check the CAP log and case 4746.
Expected_Result: No flag is set on 4746. Error 'system ID empty' with case ID 4746 is logged after up to 3 tries. 4746 stays in the normal dispatcher flow (fail-open).

Scenario: Case API unavailable: 3 retries then fail-open
Preconditions: In SIT, the Case API route is blocked (mock returns HTTP 503). Open case 4711 exists.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4747). 2) Watch the CAP log for 5 minutes. 3) As DISP_01, open the queue.
Expected_Result: Exactly 3 retries are logged, then one error entry with case ID 4747 and HTTP 503. No flag. 4747 reaches the dispatcher queue without delay caused by the check.

Scenario: Same 'case created' event delivered twice is processed once
Preconditions: Open case 4711. Ability to replay an event in SIT (event mesh / webhook replay).
Steps: 1) Create pilot case 4748 for ACME / PRD and wait for the flag. 2) Replay the same 'case created' event for 4748 (same event ID). 3) Check case 4748 change history and the event store.
Expected_Result: Case 4748 is flagged once: one field change by TU_DUPCHK in history and one 'flag set' event. The replay is logged as already processed.

Scenario: Open status list is configuration, not code
Preconditions: Open case 4750: ACME, PRD, pilot category, status 'Customer Action'. Open status list contains 'Customer Action'.
Steps: 1) Create pilot case 4751 for ACME / PRD; check it is flagged with 4750. 2) As BTP admin, remove 'Customer Action' from the open status list config (no deployment, no transport). 3) Create pilot case 4752 for ACME / PRD.
Expected_Result: 4751 is flagged with 4750. After the config change, 4752 is not flagged. No new deployment or transport was needed.

Scenario: Feature toggle switches the check off and on without a transport
Preconditions: Open case 4711. Toggle DUPLICATE_CHECK_ENABLED = true.
Steps: 1) As BTP admin, set DUPLICATE_CHECK_ENABLED = false. 2) Create pilot case 4753 for ACME / PRD. 3) Check case 4753 and the CAP log. 4) Set the toggle back to true. 5) Create pilot case 4754 for ACME / PRD.
Expected_Result: 4753 has no flag and the log shows 'check disabled' with no Case API calls. 4754 is flagged with 4711. No transport was used.

Scenario: Developers have no access to production case data; deployment needs approval
Preconditions: Developer user DEV_01 with developer role only. CI/CD pipeline with approval step.
Steps: 1) As DEV_01, try to open a production case in the Service Cloud v2 production tenant. 2) As DEV_01, try to use destination SC2_CASE_API from BAS against production. 3) As DEV_01, start a production deployment from the pipeline without approval.
Expected_Result: Steps 1 and 2 are denied. In step 3 the pipeline stops at the approval gate and nothing is deployed until an approver (not DEV_01) approves.

Scenario: CAP service stores no case free text
Preconditions: Unit test suite and SIT run completed (TC-US02-07 data).
Steps: 1) Run the unit tests. 2) In the CAP database on BTP, list all tables and columns. 3) Query for any value from case descriptions used in SIT (e.g. 'Weber').
Expected_Result: All unit tests pass (match, no match, several matches, empty system ID, API failure/retry, repeated event, no free text). The database holds only IDs, codes, counts and timestamps; step 3 returns nothing.

Scenario: Case without customer account is skipped, not matched against other customers
Preconditions: Internal agent AGT_01 can create a pilot case without an account in SIT. Open cases exist for ACME and Beta AG on PRD.
Steps: 1) As AGT_01, create a pilot case with system ID PRD and no customer account (case 4760). 2) Check the CAP log. 3) Open case 4760 as DISP_01.
Expected_Result: No flag is set; no case of ACME or Beta AG is linked. A data-quality error 'account missing' with case ID 4760 is logged. Case 4760 reaches the dispatcher normally.

Scenario: System ID entered with different spelling (lowercase / spaces)
Preconditions: Open case 4711: ACME, system ID 'PRD'.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case with system ID ' prd ' (lowercase, leading and trailing space) - case 4761. 2) Open case 4761 as DISP_01. 3) Check the CAP log.
Expected_Result: Expected [ASSUMPTION - confirm rule]: system ID is trimmed and compared case-insensitively, so 4761 is flagged with 4711. If the business decides on exact match only, 4761 is not flagged and a data-quality warning is logged. In both cases no wrong case is linked.

Scenario: Existing case has a status code not maintained in the open status list
Preconditions: A new status 'Waiting for Window' added in Service Cloud v2 but not yet in the CAP open status list. Open case 4762: ACME, PRD, pilot, status 'Waiting for Window'.
Steps: 1) Create pilot case 4763 for ACME / PRD. 2) Check case 4763 and the CAP log.
Expected_Result: 4763 is not flagged with 4762. The log shows a warning about an unknown status in the result. This confirms that status list maintenance is needed whenever case statuses change.

Scenario: Non-pilot case intake and routing are unchanged
Preconditions: F-01 active in the pilot tenant. Routing rules for category 'Performance issue' unchanged. Baseline routing result recorded before F-01.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a case category 'Performance issue', system PRD, priority 'High' (case 4770). 2) Check queue, assigned team, SLA dates and Similar Case Recommendation on 4770. 3) Compare with the baseline.
Expected_Result: Case 4770 is routed to the same queue/team with the same SLA as before F-01. No duplicate fields are filled; the CAP log shows no call for 4770. Similar Case Recommendation still shows up to 3 similar past cases.

Scenario: Standard dispatcher actions on a pilot case still work after the flag
Preconditions: Case 4771 flagged 'Possible duplicate of' = 4711 and rejected by DISP_01.
Steps: 1) As DISP_01, use the routing override on 4771 with an existing override reason (R5). 2) Change priority to 'Very High'. 3) Assign to ENG_01. 4) ENG_01 sets status 'In Process' and adds an internal note. 5) Close the case with standard reason 'Solved'.
Expected_Result: All steps work as before F-01. The override reason code list is unchanged. Duplicate fields stay as set and do not block any status change. No new flag is set when the case is edited (the check runs only on creation).

Scenario: Customer notifications and self-service flow are unchanged
Preconditions: Standard customer notifications configured (case created, case closed). Open case 4711 exists.
Steps: 1) As ACME_CUST1, create a pilot case for PRD (case 4772). 2) Check ACME_CUST1 mailbox. 3) As DISP_01, confirm the duplicate and close 4772 with reason 'Duplicate'. 4) Check the mailbox and SAP for Me again.
Expected_Result: ACME_CUST1 receives only the standard 'case created' and 'case closed' notifications, same template as before F-01. No notification mentions the duplicate check. The customer can still view, reply to and reopen the case in SAP for Me as before.
